nodes.label: Deterministic Grip Evaluation
nodes.rationale: Calculates deterministic grip score based on prize proximity to center axis, depth inside claw, and prong coverage to determine if prize reaches chute or slips.

nodes.label: Kinematic Claw Grip Anchor
nodes.rationale: Manages kinematic attachment to GripSocket, ignores collisions with prongs, applies procedural sway, and restores dynamic Rigidbody velocity upon release.

nodes.label: Modular Machine Catalog Economy
nodes.rationale: Central ScriptableObject repository for machine definitions with scaled economy tiers, higher unlock/play costs, and larger duplicate payouts.

nodes.label: Slim Skeuomorphic Control Deck
nodes.rationale: Replaces thick bottom bar with slim 16% height deck featuring ball-top joystick and 3D tactile drop button, maximizing playfield visibility to 84%.

nodes.label: Retro Arcade Cabinet Progression
nodes.rationale: Cabinet progression unlock flow requiring 150 coins to access Retro Arcade cabinet and 9 procedural retro prizes.

nodes.label: Active Claw Cable Pendulum Sway
nodes.rationale: 2D angular harmonic pendulum motion driven by trolley acceleration with shadow reticle matching swing nadir for player timing skill.

nodes.label: Dynamic Cinematic Camera Tracking
nodes.rationale: Smooth FOV and framing transitions tracking claw descent, grab tension, and prize collection tray delivery.

nodes.label: 7-Day Streak & Daily Quest Retention
nodes.rationale: Long-term player retention via 7-day login streak calendar and 3 daily rotating quests rewarding drop counts, wins, and rarities.

nodes.label: Retro Arcade Machine Specification
nodes.rationale: Second unlockable machine (150 coins, 10 coins/play, 8 coins/min passive income) with 9 procedural retro prizes.

nodes.label: Cabinet Material & Backdrop Theming Spec
nodes.rationale: Dynamic cabinet frame and backdrop colors per MachineDefinition to visually differentiate machine themes.

nodes.label: Claw Cable Pendulum Sway Kinematics
nodes.rationale: Arcade-authentic cable pendulum inertia that directly affects drop aim via 2D harmonic damped oscillation.

nodes.label: 7-Day Daily Streak & Daily Quests Retention Model
nodes.rationale: Progression retention loop scaling from 50 to 500 coins across 7 days with 3 daily rotating quests.
nodes.norm_label: 7-day daily streak & daily quests retention model

nodes.label: Physical Chute Ramp & Tray Delivery Spec
nodes.rationale: Interior 25-degree ramp directing dropped prizes into clear front tray before collection trigger fires.
